title: Amount of a Claim Reversal, Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite
content:
On the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite plans, the reversal on a resolved lost or stolen card claim takes back the part of the provisional credit posted on the claim that exceeds what the claim is due, never below zero. The reversal is limited to the available balance, and the part it cannot take stays uncollected. It is rounded half up to the cent once at the end.

**What the claim is due.** The claim is due its claimed transfer less the cardholder's liability, never below zero.
- The claimed transfer is the disputed amount less any ATM owner surcharge rebate posted on its transaction, never below zero.
- The liability is the lesser of the disputed amount and the liability limit, with a liability limit of the plan's liability cap for a loss reported on time.
- As the only claim of its loss resolved with an error found, the claim carries the loss's liability first.

**Order.** Any adjustment that replaces a figure of this method applies first. Any adjustment that adds an amount to what the claim is due applies after it, added to the amount due as figured above at no less than zero. The reversal is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Worked cases (hypothetical; liability cap for a timely report 50.00)

| | Case A | Case B | Case C |
|---|---|---|---|
| Provisional credit posted | 274.10 | 274.10 | 32.80 |
| Disputed amount | 274.10 | 274.10 | 32.80 |
| Surcharge rebate | none | none | none |
| Liability | 50.00 | 50.00 | 32.80 |
| Due | 224.10 | 224.10 | 0.00 |
| Excess | 50.00 | 50.00 | 32.80 |
| Available balance | 618.92 | 19.45 | 140.00 |
| Reversal | 50.00 | 19.45 (30.55 uncollected) | 32.80 |
